videos.title: Made Like Us
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description: Religion teaches you to fear death because you might not measure up. Hebrews 2 teaches something better — Jesus killed death by dying, voided the verdict that was coming for you, and ended a lifetime of bondage in a single moment. This is the message that sets you free.

videos.description: The law came through angels — servants delivering a shadow of what was coming. But God didn’t send another servant with another set of rules for you to try and keep. videos.title: The Last Piece of Wood
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description: Three times in Scripture, God threw wood into a problem. At Marah, the bitter water became sweet. At the Jordan, the axehead that sank floated. And at Calvary, the curse became a blessing, the dead were made alive, and the old became new.

videos.title: A Little While
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description:
The Farewell Discourse closes here. Five chapters. One night. One room and one walk. And the last word of Jesus’ teaching before He prays and enters the garden is: I have overcome.
